dict.string: Don't get caught unprepared when the &Rapocalypse comes! AntiZombies bumper comes as standard. SatNav is extra.

Welcome back to &Rthe &Rend &Rof &Rthe &Rworld! The &Pfuel is even more scarce and precious than ever! &YViolent &Ygangs are still fighting for it and our friend &GMad &GCat got himself captured by the dreaded &PJoggernaut!
Our plan is to rescue &GMad &GCat and restore as much &Ypeace &Yand &Yorder as we can! But is it really this simple?
Click below to resume the event where you stopped.
&RThanarchy seeks to collect the &YInfinity &YGems and unleash their power… in form of a slap from a giant golden hand. &OReal &Omature!
Hey you! Your friend &RMad &RCat has been captured by &PJoeggernaut! You wanna rescue him? &GCome &Gwith &Gme!
You're not gonna enter the fortress with those &Poutdated &Pmodels! Let's &Rsteal &Rone &Rof &Rtheir &Rcars!
Hey, you! What are you doing with &Rthis &Rprisonner! &PSOUND &PTHE &PALARM!
Thanks for &Ysaving &Yme! But there are &Pmore &Pprisonners who need rescuing! We need to save them!
If we want to &Psneak &Pin undetected, we're going to need some &Rwarpaint!
You thought you could &Pescape &Pme? I am the savior of these &Grotten &Gsouls!
Thank you for your help! Now that Joeggernaut has been &Ptaken &Pcare &Pof, &RI &RCAN &RBE &RTHE &RNEW &ROVERLORD!
Now that I’m the &Rruler &Rof &Rthis &Rfortress, my &Pfollowers will gladly do my bidding!
What are you doing? &RStop &Rscaring &Rmy &Rfollowers! Why can’t you just &Pjoin &Pus?
